model_annotation: Figure 15 displays the distribution of quantifiers and operations across three reasoning subfields—Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive—each represented by a separate pie chart. The third chart, “Disjunctive & Conjunctive,” is divided into two equal halves: “Disjunctive” (49.51%, light purple) and “Conjunctive” (50.49%, lavender). All three pie charts include percentage labels within their respective slices and are visually ordered with the largest slice typically positioned at the top or right. No legend is present, but the labels are self-explanatory. The charts are presented side by side, with no visual emphasis such as exploded slices.
